```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.POE")
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "POE caption"
)
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
```

::: {.content-visible when-format='html'}

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: true
if (!exists("Vs30.target") || !length(Vs30.target)) {
  Vs30.target <- .resolveValueTarget(Vref.gmdp, "Vs30.target", "POE.qmd")
}
if (!exists("Vref.target") || !length(Vref.target)) {
  Vref.target <- .resolveValueTarget(Vref.gmdp, "Vref.target", "POE.qmd")
}
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  AEPTable,
  "POE.qmd",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
  base = TRUE
)
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- p.gmdp
if (!exists("Tn.target") || !length(Tn.target)) Tn.target <- Tn.gmdp
```
